ModMetadata.Name: Controls Plus
ModMetadata.Author: James
ModMetadata.Description:
This is a Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
[h1]Controls Plus[/h1] Adds four convenient, fully rebindable controls:
[list] [*]Toggle worn sensor lenses on or off (default F7) [*]Equip or stow the first normal or advanced tablet in your inventory (default F8) [*]Equip the tools and materials needed for the next construction stage (default F9) [*]Equip the tool needed to deconstruct the current construction stage (default F10) [/list]
Both shortcuts appear under the Controls Plus group in the normal Controls settings.
Controls Plus is client-side. Dedicated servers and other players do not need to install it.
Source code and issue tracker: [url=https://github.com/jameslkingsley/ControlsPlus]github.com/jameslkingsley/ControlsPlus[/url]
ModMetadata.ChangeLog:
[h3]Version 0.2.4[/h3] [list] [*]Fixed construction when a required material is already held in the active hand [*]Hand arrangement now follows the construction requirements regardless of which hand is active [/list]
[h3]Version 0.2.3[/h3] [list] [*]Fixed deconstruction tools being rejected when their durability or charge usage exceeded one [*]Stack quantity checks now apply only to consumable construction materials [/list]
[h3]Version 0.2.2[/h3] [list] [*]Fixed Construct and Deconstruct shortcuts when the player inventory has no empty stow slot [*]Tools and held items can now swap directly between hands and compatible inventory slots [/list]
[h3]Version 0.2.1[/h3] [list] [*]Fixed Construct and Deconstruct targeting for structures whose colliders change between build states [*]Fixed shortcuts on initial iron frames and affected devices such as IC Housings and Electronics Printers [/list]
[h3]Version 0.2.0[/h3] [list] [*]Construct shortcut for equipping the next stage's tools and materials [*]Deconstruct shortcut for equipping the current stage's removal tool [*]Silent preflight when requirements are missing or held items cannot be stowed [*]Compatible replacement tools and nested player inventories are supported [/list]
[h3]Version 0.1.0[/h3] [list] [*]Initial release [*]Sensor-lenses on/off shortcut [*]Tablet and Advanced Tablet equip/stow shortcut [/list]

<size="30"><color=#ffa500>Controls Plus</color></size>
Adds rebindable shortcuts for sensor lenses, tablets, construction, and deconstruction. This is a client-side mod.
Defaults: F7 sensor lenses, F8 tablet, F9 construct, and F10 deconstruct. Rebind them under Controls Plus in the Controls settings.
Source: https://github.com/jameslkingsley/ControlsPlus
